title: Forms Blueprint Try Module Preview
description: Consolidate forms to Blueprint+Try windows, runtime Contribution/ExternalSlot mechanism, forms-module-procedural plugin for buildingComponent preview.
summary: Implemented runtime Contribution mechanism (PluginManifest.contributions, UiNode::ExternalSlot, PluginBundle::contributes, PluginHost.contributions), consolidated forms to Blueprint+Try windows with registry-driven ExternalSlot emission, extracted buildingComponent flow/tessellation into forms-module-procedural plugin, and wired ExternalSlot resolution + contributions_json injection in React os-shell, wgpu ShellState, framework-core JS utilities, dev plugin bridge, and wgpu boot.ts. Regenerated plugin registry to include forms-module-procedural; contributor plugin auto-loads alongside forms in filtered dev/wgpu sessions.
